items.title: How SK Hynix became the king of advanced memory chips
items.desc: The Economist charts SK Hynix's rise from near-bankruptcy in the early 2000s to a memory-chip powerhouse rivaling Samsung, propelled by surging AI demand for high-bandwidth memory (HBM). [Economist, posted 2026-07-16]

items.title: China's Leader Pitches 'Openness' in Push to Shape A.I.'s Future
items.desc: Xi Jinping called AI development a 'symphony of global collaboration,' positioning China as a champion of openness as Beijing works to shape the technology's global rules and standards. [NYT, posted 2026-07-17]

items.title: India Is Moving Fast to Build A.I. Data Centers. A Coastal City May Pay the Price.
items.desc: With India lagging in AI, officials are courting giant data centers, but critics warn the megaprojects will consume scarce energy and water while creating few long-term jobs. [NYT, posted 2026-07-16]

items.title: The Quest for 'Technological Sovereignty' in Europe (and Why It's So Hard)
items.desc: France and Germany want to reduce reliance on American and Chinese technology like AI, but are confronting hard trade-offs over where and how to build independent capacity. [NYT, posted 2026-07-16]
